Lena (CSM): Heads-up — NovoZyme traffic fell ~57% starting 2025-06-12. Renewal in ~6 weeks and procurement opened a short vendor review.
Omar (SE): Org: novo-prod? Which endpoints?
Lena (CSM): yes novo-prod. Quick snapshot from dashboards:
```
2025-06-10 | 9,800 calls
2025-06-11 | 9,600 calls
2025-06-12 | 4,200 calls
2025-06-13 | 4,100 calls
```
Drop concentrated on /v1/stream and nightly embed batches.
Priya (AE): Procurement said they're comparing to Competitor Q. Suggest we offer: 1) a short "operational stability + cost predictability" brief, 2) a 60-day committed burst or credits to re-run jobs, and 3) an exec QBR with capacity numbers.
billing-bot: Last invoice: 2025-05-01. Playbook: cs-onboard-v2.
Omar (SE): Infra check — no 5xx/latency spike. Likely access/token rotation or a scheduled job change on their side.
Lena (CSM): Proposed outreach: 1) 20-min triage with new Head of Engineering (Maya) + data lead (today), 2) restore service account or run our rotation flow, 3) offer a short commercial cushion (60 days committed burst or credits).
Priya (AE): I'll draft the 2-slide brief + procurement FAQ. Legal: can we fast-track a small amendment for short bursts?
Omar (SE): I'll prepare a 10-min demo showing how batching + KV cache reduces compute for their nightly runs, helps procurement see TCO upside.
Lena (CSM): Action items: @Priya draft brief + FAQ (due tomorrow), @Omar confirm infra clean and prepare demo (due EOD), @Lena schedule triage and ping Maya. I'll DM Maya now.
Priya (AE): Draft outreach below, please review before I send:
"Hi Maya — congrats on the new role. We detected a sharp drop in NovoZyme traffic after your org changes. Can we do a 20-min sync today to validate access and walk through two quick recovery paths? We can also put a short 60-day committed burst in place while procurement runs the vendor comparison. — Priya"
Omar (SE): LGTM.
billing-bot: Ticket created: CS-6120 (NovoZyme usage drop). Priority: P2.
Lena (CSM): Keeping thread active for updates — will post notes after the triage. :white_check_mark:
